description: Find the stocks with Yutai benefits, filtered by chain, tokenizer or country, with each benefit's name, what a holder must do to reach it, and whether it is only an example. A chain may be a plain name such as solana, base or arbitrum. Examples are left out unless you ask for them.

chain.description: A chain id or a plain chain name, such as solana, base or arbitrum.

country.description: The market whose stored display policy shapes the answer, as two letters such as MT. Absent reads the full policy.

includeIllustrative.description: True to include example benefits Yutai made up; absent or false keeps only real offers.

tokenizer.description: A tokenizer's public slug, such as xtokens or ondo, to keep only the stocks it tokenizes.

name: find_benefits

disclaimer.const: Benefits are voluntary programmes offered by issuers or trading venues. They are not shareholder rights, they are not investment advice, and whether one is available depends on the country.
disclaimer.description: The standard Yutai disclaimer for benefits.

benefitCount.description: How many benefits the stock offers in the chosen market, named or counted only.

illustrative.description: True when the benefit is an example Yutai made up, not an offer a real company has agreed to.

name.description: The benefit's name as the company writes it.

requirement.description: What the holder must do to reach the benefit, in the company's own short words.

company.description: The company whose stock carries the benefits.

isin.description: The stock's ISIN, in the registry's canonical spelling.

title: Find benefits
